title: Which date is the HP event, so the demo script and plan can be fixed?
bluf: The SOW says only 'December 2026'. Our records show two candidates: 1 Dec (C-03) and the Amplify slot 8-10 Dec; the draft plan assumes the week of 14 Dec. The demo script (7 minutes or less), the ready-made demo customer, fallback steps and event-day support all hang on this. Pick the date and the script and plan can be finalised. Default if you do not tap: the date stays open, the script stays a v0 draft and nothing is re-planned, at 10:00 AEDT today (2026-11-10). Tickets: HPSMPOC-5, HPSMPOC-12, HPSMPOC-172
default_action: Date stays open; nothing re-planned; script stays v0.
